groups.id: section sampling and controls share explicit pending layout
groups.comparison: 752 distinguishes measured torso/thigh bands, requested nodes and layer stations; sparse point bands use deterministic nearest fallback until min(16, available points), while triangle collection can emit up to nine samples per input triangle. 751 stops when shared status is nonzero, fits measured sections 0/12/25 into three controls, adjusts middle control for quadratic interpolation, then verifies positive interpolated ellipse radii and accumulates directional allowance. Parent761 must establish nodes>=2, buffer capacities, source ranges, special section25 and fixed word constants. No mismatched-index finding from names or count alone.

groups.id: dedicated torso input and semantic frame
groups.comparison: 753 checks domain nonempty, parallel body/skin/UV face counts, joint-name/global count and morph row/global counts. Exact nine landmarks and twelve named supporting joints are taken from the same input rig. TorsoSkinDomain derives eligible face ordinals before host selection; GpuBody and SeamTopology are fallible actual calls, but their lower admission bodies remain distinct obligations. 753 records FRAME, WIDTHS, RANK, HALF_WIDTH, SUPPORT in order against the same body count and buffers. 754 measures only front-facing, supported vertices inside the axial band; widths use negative sentinels, ranking resolves equal widths by source ordinal so the selected ninetieth-percentile slot is unique for admitted finite samples. Zero count and degenerate width set status. Later support divides by that width even after failure; this is pending device work, not accepted CPU geometry, because torso_failure rejects known status before returned armor. Native buffer initialization, count capacity and finite source contracts remain lower requirements.
